summer2026.pageDescription: Join us for the Summer event!
summer2026.features.spawnRaid.title: Spawn Island Raid
summer2026.features.spawnRaid.descriptio: fight through districts of rising difficulty, solve the puzzles to crack open the locked zones, then extract before time runs out. It's the biggest expedition map so far!
summer2026.features.shells.title: SHELLS & BATTLEPASS
summer2026.features.shells.description: Everything summer pays out in shells, the seasonal currency. Clear weekly missions (fish the warm sea, craft ice cream, hunt crabs and more) to stack shells and lottery tickets and climb the Summer Battlepass.
summer2026.features.storyline.title: SUMMER STORYLINE AND MISSIONS
summer2026.features.storyline.descriptio: Four beach locals send you all over the island: Captain Barnacle, Kai the artisan, Nalu and Zen. Their questlines are packed with exclusive summer gear and rewards.
summer2026.features.catches.title: NEW CATCHES & SHOALS
summer2026.features.catches.description: 30 new fish to reel in from fresh coastal shoals: jellyfish, seahorses, starfish, crabs and more.
summer2026.features.workshops.title: BEACH WORKSHOPS & CRAFTS
summer2026.features.workshops.descriptio: New beach workshops: cook seafood dishes (seahorse salad, jellyfish smoothie, starfish skewer), churn ice cream, and craft a whole new line of summer items and armor sets
summer2026.features.museum.title: SUMMER MUSEUM
summer2026.features.museum.description: A hidden seasonal collection: donate the 45+ summer items to complete it and claim 2 mythic + 2 legendary keys
summer2026.missions.title: Event Missions
summer2026.missions.description: Complete the following missions to earn rewards during the Summer 2026 event.
summer2026.missions.week1.title: Week 1
summer2026.missions.week1.mission1: Break washed-up bottles on the beach [50]
summer2026.missions.week1.mission5: Craft ice creams at the galeto workshop [16]
summer2026.missions.week2.title: Week 2
summer2026.missions.week2.mission1: Buy lemonade at the lemonade stand [8]
summer2026.missions.week3.title: Week 3
summer2026.missions.week3.mission1: Break washed-up bottles on the beach
summer2026.missions.week4.title: Week 4
summer2026.missions.finalWeek.title: Final Week
summer2026.battlePass.title: Event Battle Pass
summer2026.battlePass.description: Everything summer pays out in shells, the seasonal currency. Clear weekly missions (fish the warm sea, craft ice cream, hunt crabs and more) to stack shells and lottery tickets and climb the Summer Battlepass.
summer2026.lottery.title: Lottery Drops
summer2026.lottery.description: Win tickets from the quests and weekly missions, then gamble them for exclusive summer loot: cosmetics, gear and keys.
summer2026.newItems.title: New Items
summer2026.newItems.description: The following items will be added to the game during the Summer 2026 event.
